_notes: IRoLSD training-data render config: BEPICOLOMBO fixed-pose/swept-Sun + depth. trajectory_type='filepath' consumes a camera_traj.csv produced by scripts/irolsd/gen_fixedpose_sweptsun.py (pose held fixed per group, Sun swept). Earth+stars OFF => depth is spacecraft-only (paper Eq. 24) and background depth = -1. save_depth ON. Crop 1024x1024 (>=480 for label-gen; even dims). Range is set on the GENERATOR (--range), not here; trajectory_filepath must point at the Agent_0 dir the generator wrote. render_frames must be TRUE (set by the render driver).

camera._notes: MATCHES full/bepi-5000-s1 (the reference domain the frontend sees): 80mm / 6.469um px / 1024^2 native, f_px=12367. At range ~68m Bepi fills ~55% of frame, well-lit with clear structural lines. Do NOT swap back to the wide 25mm template lens (Bepi came out tiny + dark).
